title: Capital Credit Check, Reissue and Unclaimed Property Terms by Patron Class
content:
# Check, Reissue and Unclaimed Property Terms

**Product:** Capital Credits (Patronage Capital). The terms below govern capital credit checks in every patron class.

| Term | Residential | Seasonal | Farm | General Service | Irrigation | Large Power |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Calendar days after issue after which an uncashed check is stale and voided | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |
| Reissues of one payout made free of charge | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Fee deducted from a reissued check beyond the free reissues | $15.00 | $15.00 | $15.00 | $15.00 | $15.00 | $15.00 |
| Calendar months a voided payable is held after the void before it is escheated | 36 | 36 | 36 | 36 | 36 | 36 |
| Months before escheat that the last-known-address notice is mailed | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Where escheated payables go | state unclaimed property | same | same | same | same | same |

## Terms explained

- **Stale.** A check not cashed within 180 calendar days of its issue is stale and is voided.
- **Free reissues.** One reissue of a payout is made without charge; the $15.00 fee is the fee deducted from a reissued check beyond the free reissue.
- **Escheat.** A voided payable that is not reissued is held for 36 calendar months after the void and then remitted to the state as unclaimed property; the last-known-address notice is mailed 6 months before the escheat.
